user_input: Write a story about a koala's struggle with people mistaking it as a bear. Koalas are marsupials, not bears.
model_output:
Once upon a time, there was a koala named Marsupial who lived in the woods. He was a friendly and curious creature, but no one ever wanted to get too close because they were scared of him. You see, Marsupial was often mistaken for a bear, even though he was just a harmless marsupial. This caused a lot of trouble for him. People would shun him, avoid him, even hunt him at times. Most of the time, Marsupial was able to stay away from the humans, but sometimes he would wander too close and get caught in the middle of a dangerous situation. One day, things got worse when a hunter aimed his gun at Marsupial, ready to shoot. Marsupial was so scared he wanted to run away, but he was too afraid. Just then, a kind young girl came out of the woods and saw the hunter with the gun. She yelled at the hunter to stop and explained to him that Marsupial was just a harmless marsupial. The hunter was embarrassed and apologized to Marsupial, who was relieved to be safe. From then on, Marsupial was more careful to stay away from people, but he was thankful to the young girl for standing up for him.
